استغفروا (form X)
# اِسْتَغْفَرُوا (istaḡfarū) /is.taɣ.fa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اُسْتُغْفِرُوا (ustuḡfirū) /us.tuɣ.fi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اِسْتَغْفِرُوا (istaḡfirū) /is.taɣ.fi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
